headline: Zetrix AI proposed an upfront payment to be reinstated as JPJ collection agent

evidence.text: Zetrix AI has proposed an upfront payment of RM100 million towards the RM314 million in unremitted collections it owes Malaysia’s Road Transport Department (JPJ).
The company would settle the remaining RM214 million over six months in a bid to be reinstated as a JPJ revenue collection agent, The Edge Malaysia reported.
Deputy Transport Minister Datuk Hasbi Habibollah told Parliament on Monday (16 November) that the company submitted the proposal on 5 November.
The government has not yet decided whether to accept it.
The ministry is preparing a notice of demand against the company, Hasbi said.
MyEG accounted for 61.16% of JPJ revenue collected through agents as at 30 September, Hasbi said.
That share led the ministry to consider alternative collection channels before suspending the company.

According to Hasbi, the government granted earlier payment extensions because Zetrix AI, formerly MyEG Services Bhd, repeatedly promised to settle the arrears and the ministry wanted to avoid disrupting its services.
